title: The Benefit of the Doubt: Patent Examination Under Strategic Obfuscation
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. The only regressions (Table 1 and robustness Tables 1a/1b) are cross-sectional OLS of application-text measures (claims indefiniteness, inclusiveness, word counts, concreteness, Jaccard) on a continuous, time-invariant art-unit leniency measure Prior_2015 (2015 patenting rate) for applications filed 2016-2017, with robust SEs and, in robustness, year/month/entity-size FE. No binary treatment, no unit FE, no adoption timing. The paper is primarily theoretical (Figure 5 and Table 1 are the empirical part).
design_notes: replication_dataset.dta: 1,205,390 US patent applications 2015-2017 (PatentsView) with art unit, filing date, entity status, text measures. Figure5_Table1_replication.do: gen Prior_2015 = art-unit leniency in 2015; reg Y Prior_2015 if year>2015 & year<=2017, r (line 20); reghdfe ... absorb(year month small) vce(robust) (lines 32, 48). Note line 3 sets month = year(filing_date) (likely a bug; month FE collapse to year).

ineligible_specs.reason: cross-sectional regression on continuous leniency; no DiD
